readerCopy.body: The movement demanding decentralized access faces the institution determined to retain control of the system underneath it. One side points to freedom, transparency, and tools that allow people to bypass the gate; the other points to ownership, risk, and the power to shut the route down. Uranus gives the challenge reach and unpredictability, while Pluto holds the resources and consequences that can absorb or redirect it. The opposition places public disruption directly across from concentrated control. The system may change, but the outcome reveals whether power actually moved or merely learned a new interface.
